report.summary: Payments service is skipping invalid order messages due to missing amount validation, causing crashes and notifications to skip invalid payment events
report.likely_cause: Removal of MAX_AMOUNT_CENTS environment variable in payments deployment rollout
evidence: payments skipped invalid order.created messages with amount_cents=-5 (error: Input should be greater than or equal to 1)
payments deployment rollout removed MAX_AMOUNT_CENTS (was abc)

suggested_action.detail: Revert payments deployment to previous revision where MAX_AMOUNT_CENTS was set to prevent invalid amount validation

rule_verdict.cause: a producer sent events that fail validation
